name: dsh-code-card-fonts
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: 14px conversation-card titles, summaries, content, code and markdown table cells, plus message-card spacing of calc(14px * 0.5) = 7px. The content font-size axis (the ui-theme font-size setting) is no longer overridden, so body text and line heights stay user-adjustable. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
